name: Human3.6M
description: A large-scale motion-capture dataset of 3.6 million 3D human poses, synchronized with video from multiple cameras, for human pose estimation and motion analysis. This record does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Ionescu, C., Papava, D., Olaru, V., & Sminchisescu, C. (2014). Human3.6M: Large Scale Datasets and Predictive Methods for 3D Human Sensing in Natural Environments. IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, 36(7), 1325–1339. https://doi.org/10.1109/TPAMI.2013.248
